sources.title: Kimi K2 - Open Agentic Intelligence | 1T MoE | Moonshot AI
sources.snippet: Kimi K2 by Moonshot AI - 1 trillion parameter open-source MoE model with 32B active parameters, 128K context, MuonClip optimizer, exceptional coding, reasoning, and agentic capabilities. Released July 2025 under Modified MIT License.

sources.title: MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2.5: Open Visual Agentic Intelligence - GitHub
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.5 is an open-source, native multimodal agentic model built through continual pretraining on approximately 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens atop Kimi-K2-Base. It seamlessly integrates vision and language understanding with advanced agentic capabilities, instant and thinking modes, as well as conversational and agentic paradigms.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: These results position Kimi K2 as one of the most capable open-source large language models to date, particularly in software engineering and agentic tasks. We release our base and post-trained model checkpoints 1 to facilitate future research and applications of agentic intelligence.

sources.title: Kimi K3 - Kimi API Platform
sources.snippet: Kimi K3 is the first open-source model to reach 2.8 trillion parameters. This is the latest step in Kimi's continued push of model-scale boundaries: in 9 of the past 12 months (2025/07-2026/07), Kimi models have maintained the frontier in open-source model scale. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes).
